policy.selection: one shared step per recipe; mean(draws) per seed then mean(seeds)
policy.alternate: evaluate exact frozen step; no alternate checkpoint/recipe selection
policy.duration_transfer: same optimizer updates AND full LR horizon on every fold/final
policy.mvp: historical outer-selected reference; NOT unbiased independent test
policy.masks: automatic anonymized-region diagnostic, NOT verified plate-only
policy.junk: unchanged official adapter; extra same-camera diagnostic only

extension.decision: additional seeds requested after seeing first outer; not a fresh independent test
extension.aggregation: all three seeds equally; sample SD and paired deltas; no best-seed choice or ensemble
extension.thresholds: each model calibrated separately on original calibration only
